content.title: How to watch UCLA vs UCF with Sling TV
content.text: BLOGSPORTSCOLLEGE BASKETBALLHOW TO WATCH UCLA VS UCF WITH SLING TV#7 UCLA vs. #10 UCF Prediction, Odds, & How to Watch: March Madness® 2026#7 UCLA and #10 UCF collide at the Xfinity Mobile Arena for a pivotal South Region matchup. Here are details, our prediction, and how to watch with Sling TV.The No. 7 seed UCLA Bruins enter the tournament after a deep run to the Big Ten Tournament semifinals, where they fell to eventual champion Purdue. They face a No. 10 seed UCF Knights squad making its first March Madness® appearance in seven years after an impressive at-large campaign in the Big 12. While UCLA relies on a disciplined offense that ranks among the best at protecting the ball, the Knights bring a physical, high-rebounding style that could test the Bruins' interior.To Watch the Bruins vs. Knights First Round game with Sling, use the link below for a 1 Day Pass subscription to TBS or a monthly subscription to Sling Orange or Blue.Game DetailInformationMatchup#7 UCLA vs. #10 UCFDate/TimeFriday, March 20, 2026 | 7:25 PM ETLocationXfinity Mobile Arena, Philadelphia, PAChannelTBSWatch With Sling1, 3, & 7 Day Pass or a monthly subscription to Sling Orange or Blue.Opening SpreadUCLA -5.5 to -6.5 (O/U 152.5 to 153.0)UCLA Bruins Analysis Season Overview: UCLA (23-11) finished 6th in the Big Ten and reached the conference tournament semifinals, fueled by three home wins over top-10 teams. Star Player: Tyler Bilodeau (F). The senior forward leads the Bruins in scoring (17.6 PPG) and rebounding (5.6 RPG), providing an essential interior presence. The X-Factor: Ball Security. The Bruins rank 6th nationally in turnover percentage (8.9 TOV/game), allowing them to maximize possessions against more aggressive defenses. UCF Knights Analysis Season Overview: UCF (21-11) secured an at-large bid after recording five Quad 1 wins, including an upset of Kansas. Star Player: Riley Kugel (G). The senior transfer leads a veteran backcourt with 14.4 PPG and provides elite perimeter playmaking. The Upset Formula: Offensive Rebounding. The Knights rank among the best in the nation at second-chance opportunities, grabbing offensive rebounds on 34.4% of their misses. Key Matchup & Advanced Analytics Position Battle: Donovan Dent (UCLA) vs. Themus Fulks (UCF). This battle of senior guards features two elite facilitators; Dent averages 7.6 APG, while Fulks counters with 6.7 APG. Statistical Edge: UCLA holds a significant advantage in shooting efficiency, ranking 16th nationally in three-point percentage (38.2%) compared to UCF’s inconsistent perimeter defense. Betting Trends: UCLA opened as a 5.5-point favorite, with the line moving toward -6.5 at several sportsbooks following their strong Big Ten Tournament showing. Final Prediction & Betting Pick The Verdict: UCLA Bruins. Final Score Prediction: UCLA 79, UCF 72. Best Bet: UCLA -5.5.
